slides.say: Use memo caches the result of a calculation between renders. But first, check that the calculation is actually slow.
Measure it. Unless you loop over thousands of objects, it is probably cheap. Around one millisecond or more might be worth memoizing.
Wrap it in use memo with its dependencies. React re-runs it only when todos or tab change.

slides.text: It won’t speed up the first render. React may also drop the cache: use it only as an optimization.
slides.say: It will not make the first render faster. And React may throw the cache away, so only rely on it as an optimization.
